defs.def: to do sth more quickly than usual because there is not much time 赶快，匆忙，急忙（做某事）

ex.s: All this adds up to a state of hurry
ex.t: 所有这一切加起来就是一种匆忙的状态。

ex.s: They are usually in a hurry.
Before Vinnie could say yes, the President hurried on, a shade of apology in his voice.
ex.t: 温妮还没来得及答应，总统便匆匆继续说，声音里带着一丝歉意。

ex.s: （2）Why did the author hurry back home without reaching the top of the mountain？ Give two reasons．（no more than 15 words）
ex.t: （2）作者为什么没有到达山顶就匆忙回家？给出两个原因。（不超过15个词）

ex.s: He was in a hurry          D.
He hurried home, never once looking back to see if he __________.
ex.t: 他匆忙回家，从未回头看一眼他是否__________。

ex.s: After class on Wednesday, I hurried to the school skateboarding club.
ex.t: 星期三下课后，我匆匆赶到学校的滑板俱乐部。

ex.s: Sorry I was in a big hurry then.
The tiger looked shocked and hurried away.
ex.t: 老虎看起来吓了一跳，匆忙跑开了。

ex.s: When I hurried to the store, I saw that the books were already being packed into boxes.
ex.t: 当我匆忙赶到书店时，看到那些书已经在被打包装箱了。

ex.s: Past continuous passive a When I hurried to the store, I saw that the books were already being packed into boxes.
ex.t: 过去进行时的被动语态：当我匆忙赶到书店时，看到那些书已经在被打包装箱了。

defs.def: to move quickly in a particular direction （朝某方向）迅速移动
to make sb do sth more quickly 催促（某人）
to deal with sth quickly 迅速处理
to do sth too quickly 仓促（做某事）
very quickly or more quickly than usual 迅速；赶快
not having enough time to do sth 仓促；匆忙
having plenty of time 有足够的时间，不着急（做某事）
not wanting or not willing to do sth 不想，不情愿（做某事）
